# OpenBooth
> A synchronized 2-player private virtual photobooth designed for distant lovers, friends, and duos.

## Overview
OpenBooth provides ultra-low-latency WebRTC dual-camera feeds, simultaneous 4-shot synchronized burst captures, and retro-futuristic keepsake strip generation. All media capture is computed client-side within browser memory for privacy and zero data leakage.

## Architecture
- Dual peer-to-peer WebRTC video channels with STUN fallback
- Salted SHA-256 room password protection
- In-memory ephemeral signaling
- No persistent image storage; photostrips are exported directly to local PNG on device
